memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Follow‑up for generalised anxiety, migraine prophylaxis and sciatica. EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 78 kg, BMI 24.3 (overweight). Advised diet and activity. Neurological exam normal, straight leg raise negative. IMPRESSION: Stable anxiety, migraine prophylaxis adequate, sciatica mild. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, propranolol 40 mg OD, sumatriptan 50 mg SOS, topiramate 25 mg HS, naproxen 500 mg SOS, pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, TSH, Hb. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Increased worry and occasional migraine despite prophylaxis. EXAMINATION: BP 130/84 mmHg, weight 79 kg, BMI 24.9 (overweight). Advised diet and activity. Neurological exam normal, straight leg raise negative. IMPRESSION: Anxiety partially controlled, consider increasing escitalopram; migraine prophylaxis adequate; sciatica stable. ARRANGEMENTS: Increase escitalopram to 10 mg OD, continue other meds. Repeat GAD‑7 in 4 weeks. Return if worsening anxiety, severe headache with visual changes, fever >39°C, or urinary symptoms.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: New tingling in legs, mild worsening of back pain. EXAMINATION: BP 132/86 mmHg, weight 81 kg, BMI 25.4 (obese). Advised diet and activity. Straight leg raise positive on left at 40°. IMPRESSION: Anxiety stable; migraine controlled; sciatica worsening, consider neuropathic adjunct. ARRANGEMENTS: Stop buspirone due to dizziness, start pregabalin 75 mg BD (already on, increase to 150 mg BD). Continue other meds. Return if severe leg weakness, bowel/bladder changes, fever >39°C, or chest pain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Good control of anxiety, occasional migraine breakthrough. EXAMINATION: BP 130/82 mmHg, weight 80 kg, BMI 25.0 (obese). Advised diet and activity. Neurological exam normal, straight leg raise negative. IMPRESSION: Anxiety stable on escitalopram 10 mg; migraine prophylaxis adequate but needs acute therapy; sciatica improved with pregabalin. ARRANGEMENTS: Keep escitalopram 10 mg OD, increase propranolol to 60 mg OD for better migraine prevention, continue sumatriptan SOS. Return if worsening headache with neurological signs, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.
